# Ready.gov

> > Official FEMA and DHS emergency preparedness resource providing disaster planning guides, safety protocols, and emergency response information for individuals, families, businesses, and communities.

Ready.gov serves as the primary public-facing disaster preparedness platform from the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The site offers comprehensive resources in English and Spanish covering natural disasters, emergency planning, business continuity, and specialized guidance for vulnerable populations including older adults, caregivers, and youth.

## Key Topics

- Emergency Planning
- Disaster Preparedness
- FEMA
- Emergency Kits
- Evacuation Planning
- Business Continuity
- Natural Disasters
- Severe Weather
- Older Adults & Senior Safety
- Caregiver Resources
- CERT (Community Emergency Response Team)
- NOAA Weather Radio
- National Weather Service
- First Aid & Home Safety
- Youth Preparedness Programs

## Natural Disasters & Severe Weather

- [Earthquakes](https://www.ready.gov/earthquakes): Earthquake safety guide covering drop-cover-hold and preparedness steps
- [Pandemics](https://www.ready.gov/pandemic): Pandemic preparedness guide with CDC vaccination and safety protocols
- [Tiempo Severo (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/tiempo-severo): Spanish severe weather guide covering tornadoes, floods, and storms
- [Tsunamis (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/tsunamis): Spanish tsunami preparedness and coastal evacuation safety guide
- [Apagones - Power Outages (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/apagones): Spanish guide for power outage safety including generators and CO risks
- [Calor extremo - Extreme Heat (Spanish Kids)](https://www.ready.gov/es/kids/disaster-facts/extreme-heat): Spanish kids' guide to extreme heat and heat wave safety

## Vulnerable Populations & Caregiving

- [Older Adults](https://www.ready.gov/older-adults): Emergency planning guide for seniors with disaster preparedness tips
- [Caregivers](https://www.ready.gov/caregivers): FEMA and RCI disaster preparedness guide for caregivers and recipients

## Business Emergency Planning

- [Ready Business](https://www.ready.gov/business): Main business emergency planning and workplace safety preparedness hub
- [Testing & Exercises](https://www.ready.gov/business/training/testing-exercises): Business continuity testing and emergency exercise planning guide
- [Plan de respuesta a emergencias (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/business/emergency-plans/emergency-response-plan): Spanish business emergency response plan development guide

## Family & Youth Preparedness

- [Build a Kit (Kids)](https://www.ready.gov/kids/family-emergency-planning/build-a-kit): Kids' guide to building family emergency supply kits for disasters
- [Start a Program (Youth)](https://www.ready.gov/kids/start-program): Youth preparedness program implementation guide with FEMA resources
- [Adolescentes - Teens (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/kids/teens): Spanish teen disaster preparedness and CERT youth leadership resources
- [Comunicación Con La Familia (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/node/169): Spanish family emergency communication planning with contact cards

## Home Safety & First Aid

- [Seguridad del hogar (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/seguridad-del-hogar): Spanish home safety guide covering injury prevention and first aid
- [Prevención y tratamiento de quemaduras (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/prevencion-y-tratamiento-de-quemaduras): Spanish burn prevention and first aid treatment guide for home safety
- [Seguridad cibernética (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/ataque-cibernetico): Spanish cybersecurity guide covering cyber attacks and digital protection

## Community Programs & Training

- [Community Preparedness Webinar: Program Sustainability](https://www.ready.gov/community-preparedness-webinar-series-program-sustainability): Webinar on Citizen Corps funding and program sustainability strategies

## Optional

- [Aviso sobre interrupción de fondos federales (Spanish)](https://www.ready.gov/es/aviso-del-impacto-de-la-interrupcion-de-fondos-federales-en-las-operaciones-de-las-redes-sociales): Spanish notice about FEMA website operations during federal funding lapse
